## CROSS-DOMAIN FLOWS

End-to-end flows that cross domain boundaries. Each step lists the domain.

### Block Production
```
node (production/mod.rs) -> node (production/assembly.rs) -> core (BlockBuilder) ->
core (epoch_state) -> core (scheduler) -> node (apply_block) ->
storage (StateDb batch + BlockStore) -> network (broadcast_block) -> network (gossip publish)
```

### Block Ingestion (Gossip)
```
network (gossip receive) -> network (rate_limit check) -> network (scoring) ->
node (handle_new_block) -> node (classify_gossip_block) -> node (check_producer_eligibility) ->
core (validate_block) -> node (apply_block) -> storage (StateDb batch + BlockStore) ->
network (SyncManager update_local_tip)
```

### Transaction Submission
```
cli/gui -> wallet (TxBuilder sign_and_build) -> rpc (sendTransaction) ->
mempool (add_transaction) -> core (validate_transaction) -> storage (UtxoSet lookup) ->
network (broadcast_transaction) -> network (gossip publish)
```

### Sync (Header-First)
```
network (SyncManager gap detection) -> network (RequestSync GetHeaders) ->
network (SyncResponse Headers) -> network (RequestSync GetBodies) ->
network (SyncResponse Bodies) -> node (apply_block loop) ->
storage (StateDb + BlockStore) -> network (SyncManager update_local_tip)
```

### Snap Sync
```
network (SyncManager gap > 50) -> network (GetStateRoot quorum) ->
network (GetStateSnapshot) -> node (apply_snap_snapshot) ->
storage (StateDb atomic_replace) -> storage (BlockStore seed_canonical_index) ->
network (post-snap header sync)
```

### Epoch Boundary
```
node (build_block_content at epoch start) -> node (calculate_epoch_rewards) ->
storage (BlockStore block scan) -> core (EpochReward TX creation) ->
node (apply_block) -> node (post_commit_actions) ->
core (EpochState derive_at_boundary) -> storage (StateDb batch persist)
```

### Fork Recovery
```
network (RecoveryCoordinator report_evidence) -> network (classify_and_dispatch) ->
node (rollback_one_block or resync) -> storage (StateDb undo restore) ->
node (apply new chain) -> network (SyncManager update)
```

### Auto-Update
```
updater (fetch_latest_release from GitHub) -> updater (verify_release_signatures) ->
updater (VoteTracker) -> updater (VersionEnforcement) ->
updater (auto_apply_from_github) -> updater (install_binary) ->
updater (UpdateWatchdog record_update) -> updater (restart_node)
```

### State Root Diagnosis
```
rpc (getStateRootDebug) -> storage (compute_state_root) ->
storage (ChainState serialize_canonical + UtxoSet serialize_canonical + ProducerSet serialize_canonical) ->
crypto (BLAKE3 hash per component)
```

### Bridge Swap
```
cli (bridge-lock) -> wallet (TxBuilder) -> rpc (sendTransaction) ->
bridge (DoliClient scan_for_htlcs) -> bridge (BitcoinClient/EthereumClient scan) ->
bridge (SwapRecord state machine) -> bridge (preimage reveal detection)
```
